name: Salt Typhoon
description: Salt Typhoon is a PRC-affiliated APT focused on espionage and intelligence collection, primarily targeting telecommunications infrastructure. Confirmed by FBI in February 2026 as an active and ongoing threat. Relies heavily on living-off-the-land techniques to blend into legitimate network traffic and evade endpoint detection. Represents one of the most serious confirmed penetrations of US infrastructure by a foreign adversary in decades.

ttps.notes: Known CVEs and basic configuration errors provide initial entry
LOTL — PowerShell for execution and persistence
WMIC for lateral movement and execution

ttps.technique_name: Create or Modify System Process: Windows Service

ttps.notes: C2 over legitimate protocols to blend into traffic

notable_techniques: Living-off-the-land throughout — PowerShell, WMIC, registry manipulation blend into legitimate admin activity
Targets telecom lawful intercept infrastructure — access to call records and communications of government officials
Long dwell time — confirmed presence in US telecom networks measured in months before detection
FBI confirmed active and ongoing threat as of February 2026
detection_opportunities: Anomalous WMIC remote execution from non-admin systems
PowerShell with encoded commands spawned by unusual parent processes
New Windows services created outside patch/deployment windows
Outbound C2 over HTTP/HTTPS to recently registered domains
Lateral movement via legitimate admin protocols from unexpected source systems
response_playbook: Hunt for WMIC remote execution originating from non-administrative source systems.
Review newly created Windows services for unauthorized persistence, especially outside patch/deployment windows.
Audit PowerShell execution for encoded commands launched by unusual parent processes.
Given this group's long dwell times, extend log review to 6-12 months on telecom and lawful-intercept-adjacent systems.
Inspect outbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic to recently registered domains for GhostSpider/SparrowDoor/SnappyBee C2.
If telecom infrastructure is involved, coordinate with carrier security teams given this actor's specific focus on call-record and lawful-intercept systems.
